title: raimannia heterophylla
intro: Raimannia heterophylla, commonly known as the New Caledonian tree fern, is a species of tree fern native to New Caledonia. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Raimannia heterophylla include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of Raimannia heterophylla include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
